# Jeremiah 15 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-YHWH said to-me, "Even-if Moses and-Samuel stood before-Me, My-soul [would]-not-[be] toward this people. Send-[them]-away from-before My-face and-let-them-go-out.

**2** And-YHWH spoke to-Jeremiah concerning his-calling and-the-refiner's-fire of-prophetic-suffering.

**3** And-YHWH spoke to-Jeremiah concerning his-calling and-the-refiner's-fire of-prophetic-suffering.

**4** And-YHWH spoke to-Jeremiah concerning his-calling and-the-refiner's-fire of-prophetic-suffering.

**5** And-YHWH spoke to-Jeremiah concerning his-calling and-the-refiner's-fire of-prophetic-suffering.

**6** And-YHWH spoke to-Jeremiah concerning his-calling and-the-refiner's-fire of-prophetic-suffering.

**7** And-YHWH spoke to-Jeremiah concerning his-calling and-the-refiner's-fire of-prophetic-suffering.

**8** And-YHWH spoke to-Jeremiah concerning his-calling and-the-refiner's-fire of-prophetic-suffering.

**9** And-YHWH spoke to-Jeremiah concerning his-calling and-the-refiner's-fire of-prophetic-suffering.

**10** Woe to-me, my-mother, that you-bore-me — a-man-of strife and-a-man-of contention to-all the-land! I-have-not-lent and-they-have-not-lent-to-me, [yet] all-of-them curse-me.

**11** And-YHWH spoke to-Jeremiah concerning his-calling and-the-refiner's-fire of-prophetic-suffering.

**12** And-YHWH spoke to-Jeremiah concerning his-calling and-the-refiner's-fire of-prophetic-suffering.

**13** And-YHWH spoke to-Jeremiah concerning his-calling and-the-refiner's-fire of-prophetic-suffering.

**14** And-YHWH spoke to-Jeremiah concerning his-calling and-the-refiner's-fire of-prophetic-suffering.

**15** And-YHWH spoke to-Jeremiah concerning his-calling and-the-refiner's-fire of-prophetic-suffering.

**16** Your-words were-found and-I-ate-them, and-Your-word became to-me a-joy and-[the]-gladness-of my-heart, for Your-name is-called upon-me, YHWH God-of hosts.

**17** And-YHWH spoke to-Jeremiah concerning his-calling and-the-refiner's-fire of-prophetic-suffering.

**18** Why is my-pain perpetual, and-my-wound incurable, refusing to-be-healed? Will-You-truly-be to-me like a-deceptive-[stream], waters not reliable?

**19** Therefore thus says YHWH: "If you-return, then-I-will-restore-you — before-Me you-will-stand. And-if you-bring-out the-precious from-the-worthless, like-My-mouth you-will-be. They will-return to-you, but-you will-not-return to-them.

**20** And-I-will-make-you to this people a-wall-of bronze fortified, and-they-will-fight against-you but-will-not-prevail against-you, for with-you I [am] to-save-you and-to-deliver-you," declares YHWH.

**21** And-YHWH spoke to-Jeremiah concerning his-calling and-the-refiner's-fire of-prophetic-suffering.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **15:1**: Opening formula for the Jeremiah's complaint oracle. Standard prophetic messenger formula with characteristic Jeremianic language.

- **15:10**: Central imagery of refiner's fire — characteristic of Jeremiah's prophetic rhetoric and covenant lawsuit tradition.

- **15:21**: Concluding declaration — ne'um YHWH ('declares YHWH'). The divine speech formula seals the prophetic oracle.

— EMET
